# Cloud Readiness Analyzer Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills

## Overview

Use when analyzing application cloud readiness against 12-Factor App principles and cloud-native maturity model.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [cloud-readiness-analyzer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
cloud-readiness-analyzer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@cloud-readiness-analyzer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze business processes and identify improvement opportunities
- Apply domain best practices and industry-standard frameworks
- Assess current state against maturity models and benchmarks
- Generate findings with severity classification and remediation guidance

## Industry Standards Applied

- **Well-Architected Framework**: Cloud architecture pillars: security, reliability, performance, cost, operations
- **12-Factor App**: Methodology for building cloud-native, scalable services
- **CIS Benchmarks**: Security configuration baselines for cloud platforms
